📜 Important Rules & Instructions

  • Students must carry a printed or digital copy of their official Hall Ticket.
  • Arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes prior to your scheduled time slot.
  • Please send your payment screenshot to WhatsApp 9913462976.
  • Audio questions will be broadcasted clearly; listening focus is paramount.
  • No electronic devices or calculators are allowed during the competition.
  • Entry fee of ₹200 is non-refundable once submitted.
  • For any problem or query, contact us on 9913462976.
  • If you do not send payment screenshot, registration will not be considered.
